_: TAXONOMY ROOT INDEX. Lists the shards that make up the academic taxonomy and the tiers above them. Everything below a program lives in a shard so the client never has to hold every syllabus in memory. See TAXONOMY-CONTRACT.md before editing — this is a data file, and adding a course must never require a code change. Shards named legacy-* are GENERATED by tools/gen-legacy-taxonomy.js from the coverage that used to live as JavaScript literals in index.html; the generator owns them and documents the six mapping decisions. Hand-authored shards and generated ones sit side by side on purpose: the hand-authored ones carry depth (units, topics, problem_types), the generated ones carry breadth (465 courses), and where they name the same thing the hand-authored node wins.
